name: BALANCED64_V1
purpose: standard fast-anchor window set (fast anchors, previews, per-class reads)
design: class-stratified selection minimizing per-class+global bias vs full-512 jointly on BOTH sealed reference wires (pre-repair BANANA_SMASHER 0.12837 + dosed U030 0.08395); 20k random starts + greedy swap refinement
holdout_error_budget: per-class ±4% (est. from single-wire-design cross-validation showing ±8% worst-case; dual-wire design halves it), global ±1-2%
usage_law: BALANCED64 rows are labeled balanced64_v1; NEVER silently mixed with 512w grid rows; every future full-512 run on any wire MUST log BALANCED64-subset-vs-full512 residuals as a free ongoing holdout audit; set is FROZEN (no reselection without version bump)
